item.title: BOLOGNA v CELTIC: 5-MINUTE QUIZ
item.description: CELTIC face Bologna in the Europa League in the 5.45pm kick-off in Italy this evening. item.title: Bologna have their own challenges
item.description: I was chastised by a pal last week when I suggested the Europa League was an irrelevance right now. “We are Celtic,” he said, “We have to be competing in every competition.” Indeed. item.title: ‘I AM READY TO GET GOING,’ INSISTS NEW BHOY TOMAS
item.description: TOMAS ČVANCARA has completed the formalities to seal his loan move to Celtic until the end of the season. The eight times-capped Czech Republic striker’s move from Borussia Monchengladbach was completed while interim boss Martin O’Neill was with the squad in Italy for tonight’s Europa League game against Bologna. item.title: CONFIRMED: O’NEILL OPTS FOR OLD GUARD
item.description: MARTIN O’NEILL has made wholesale changes in his Celtic line-up to face Bologna in the Europa League in Italy this evening. Kasper Schmeichel returns to goal while Daizen Maeda leads the attack. Reo Hatate also makes a return in the midfield alongside skipper Callum McGregor and Arne Engels. item.title: BOLOGNA 2 CELTIC 2: REO SEES RED AS 10 HEROES HOLD OUT
item.description: BOLOGNA 2 CELTIC 2 REO HATATE was red-carded as 10-man Celtic heroically held out for a point in Bologna this evening. It was an awesome performance of courage of backs-to-the-wall and never-say-die defending from Martin O’Neill’s men as their hopes of advancing to the knock-out phase of the Europa League remained alive. item.title: ‘BREATHLESS’ AND ‘COLOSSAL’, O’NEILL HAILS HIS HEROES
item.description: MARTIN O’NEILL admitted he was “breathless” after Celtic’s courageous 10 men earned a crucial Europa League point in a tension-laded 2-2 draw against Bologna in Italy last night.
